name: Dream Hunter Remu -Nemureru Jashin-
original_name: ドリームハンター麗夢 睡れる邪神
source:
A nukige parodying Dream Hunter Remu. 
She had a phone call. But the client dies an unnatural death in an hotel room. 

[Slightly edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029252.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以《梦猎人丽梦》为题材的色情游戏。
丽梦接到了一通电话，然而，委托人却在酒店房间里离奇死亡。

[略作编辑，摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029252.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
